newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Negara says buying Dutch bank stake.
newsitem.headline: Negara says buying Dutch bank stake.

text.p: Indonesia largest state-owned bank PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI), said on Tuesday that it is in the process of buying a stake in N.V. De Indonesische Overzeese Bank (Indover) in Amsterdam.

"What I can say now is that Bank Negara Indonesia is in the process of purchasing shares owned by Indonesia's central bank, Bank Indonesia, in Indover bank," BNI president director Widigdo Sukarman told a news conference after an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders.
Sukarman declined to give further details about the acquisition but said it was aimed at strenghening BNI's network in Europe.
He also said that the acquisition plan would be subject to shareholder approval at a later meeting.
The bank said that the due diligence process was expected to be completed in August.
